scope: Historical five-seed validation panel behind dope-mfs.tex. Successor campaign claims (N21) are out of scope until measured; they never enter this registry as facts.

estimands.retention_level: Median over lineages of null-normalized TSTR/TRTR retention, with the 95% cluster, lineage and fit-seed nested bootstrap interval.
estimands.paired_difference: Hodges-Lehmann pseudo-median of paired lineage differences, DOPE minus comparator, with the 95% nested bootstrap interval. A raw-gap superiority (or inferiority) verdict requires that interval to exclude zero; otherwise the verdict is inconclusive. Equivalence is a separate rule (90% interval inside the margin) and is never inferred from an inconclusive verdict.
estimands.charged_bytes: Median over lineages of the per-lineage median charged artifact bytes over completed fits; every byte that sampling reads is charged.
estimands.cap_share: Completed DOPE fits whose charged bytes are within the 10,240-byte cap, over all completed fits.
estimands.panel_size: Distinct prepared lineages in the v2 scalar ledger.
estimands.disclosure: A required statement whose evidence is a flag in the panel, not an estimate.

states.measured: An estimate on validation rows; selection-exposed, as every estimate in this panel.
states.above: Raw-gap superiority on validation rows; interval excludes zero above it.
states.below: Raw-gap inferiority on validation rows; interval excludes zero below it.
states.inconclusive: The interval contains zero. The paper says 'cannot be separated from', which is not equivalence.
states.null_with_reason: The quantity is unmeasured and printed as null with the gates that keep it null.
states.pending: Reserved for a future pre-registered run; nothing is reported.

manuscript_phrases: The release score is null until its privacy and representation gates are measured

applies_to: README prose outside the generated block
